gaps.explanation: The utility funds appear in detail[] only through their expenditure lines from the Combined Budget and Actual - All Fund Types schedule (p9: Sanitation 172,390, Sewer 44,117, Water 52,260 = business-type disbursements 268,767). That schedule prints revenues only for all funds combined (Property taxes / Intergovernmental / Local / Federal / Transfers in, no utility split), so no utility revenue line is in detail[]. The Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds (p6) prints them per fund column: Water - Charges for services 81,723, Miscellaneous 10, Interest income 262; Sewer - Charges for services 30,901, Interest income 271; Sanitation - Charges for services 49,410, Interest income 51. Sum 81,723 + 10 + 262 + 30,901 + 271 + 49,410 + 51 = 162,628 = total operating revenues 162,044 + interest income 584 (p6 Total column). Schedule 0 + 162,628 = 162,628 = statement total. Fund names follow the existing detail lines for these columns (Water Fund, Sewer Fund, Sanitation Fund; p6 headings Water / Sewer / Sanitation).
